column1: # Walking access to the subway per hexagon (street network)
#   - MTA Subway Entrances and Exits: 2024 (data.ny.gov i9wp-a4ja)
#   - OSMnx documentation (walk network filter used here): https://osmnx.readthedocs.io/
#   walk_to_entrance_m: walking distance from the hexagon center to the nearest subway entrance
#   straight_to_entrance_m: straight-line distance from the center to the nearest entrance
#   walk_capped: 1 if the real walk is over 5
#   detour_ratio: walk / straight-line (1.0 = direct; high = rivers
column2: yards or highways in the way); uncapped walk

column1: #   center_snap_m: distance from the center to the nearest walkable path (large = center in a park
#   walk_within_400: 1 if the center is within a 400 m walk of an entrance (about 5 minutes)
#   walk_within_800: 1 if the center is within an 800 m walk of an entrance (about 10 minutes)
#   complexes_800m_walk: number of station complexes with an entrance within an 800 m walk
#   walkshed_800_km2: area reachable within an 800 m walk (concave hull of reachable nodes + 25 m)
#   walkshed_ratio: walkshed area / area of an 800 m circle (2.01 km²); low = poor street grid or water
#   street_km_800m_walk: km of walkable streets and paths within an 800 m walk
#   intersections_per_km2: street/path intersections (3+ segments) per km² of hexagon land
#   Walking speed is not assumed; divide by ~80 m/min for minutes.

column2: 000 nodes are dropped; centers are snapped to the nearest remaining node and the snap distance is added.
